## Summary

I implemented F001, the scope-signal lint core, as a new pure package `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/plan_review/` (`lint.py` + `__init__.py`). The module exposes `lint_feature(feature, resolvers)` — a pure function (no network, no I/O, no argument mutation) that returns a typed `ScopeReport(feature_id, surfaces, ac_count, flags)` whose flags carry `kind ∈ {over_surface, over_ac, exemplar_ac, weak_test, missing_prereq, likely_timeout}`, a severity band, and the evidence that fired each one.
